lines.text: Astra's films start much sooner, in about a second on a slow link, and resuming is as quick. Less is fetched ahead.
Settings, Playback has Get ready ahead: Astra reads your TorBox list early and prepares the next episode.
Sound has Even loudness and Headphone surround. Picture has an Animation upscaler, and HDR films can be sharpened.
Dolby sound plays straight through where your phone can decode it. Every film Astra can read gets its full player.
